reviewers.summary: The checklist omits required role-specific working views. The reset and View as tests cover component callbacks but do not verify the App-level safeguards and request behavior required by their acceptance criteria.

findingList.message: The guided checklist does not provide the role-specific finance reserve and legal obligations views required by the acceptance criterion.

evidence.codePathTraced: getPresenterGuidedChecklist accepts only caseId and returns the same five routes for every persona; the Case route always ends in /overview.
evidence.failureScenario: After switching to finance or legal, the presenter follows the checklist and gets only generic /work and case overview links, with no direct finance reserve or legal obligations view as required.

findingList.message: The named reset test does not cover the acceptance criterion's scoped server command, CSRF, and revision safeguards.

evidence.codePathTraced: presenter_scoped_reset_actions renders PresenterDemoControl directly and checks only that the component hides a button for canReset=false and invokes a callback for canReset=true; it does not exercise App.tsx or submitHangarCaseReset.
evidence.failureScenario: If App.tsx stops checking presenter case scope or stops sending the CSRF token and revision through the existing reset command, this test still passes.

findingList.message: The named View as test does not verify the required switch-user request, CSRF, or navigation-after-success behavior.

evidence.codePathTraced: AC_004_presenter_view_as_contract verifies only that the component calls onViewAs with persona IDs; it does not exercise App.tsx's handleRoleSwitch integration.
evidence.failureScenario: If the App integration omits the switch-user POST, CSRF token, or waits incorrectly before navigating, this test still passes.

reviewers.summary: The guided checklist uses generic routes instead of the required role-specific working views. The persona test checks only a mocked callback, so it cannot catch failures in the role-switch request and navigation behavior.

findingList.message: The guided path does not link to the role-specific main working views required by the criterion, including technical findings, finance reserve, and legal obligations.

evidence.codePathTraced: getPresenterGuidedChecklist returns the same fixed routes for every case and persona; the Case link always targets /cases/{caseId}/overview.
evidence.failureScenario: After choosing the finance or legal persona, following the Case link opens the generic overview rather than the required finance reserve or legal obligations view.

findingList.message: AC_004 is not tested through the production role-switch path. Add coverage that verifies the switch-user request, CSRF, success-gated navigation, and unchanged session on rejection or an unknown persona.

evidence.codePathTraced: AC_004_presenter_view_as_contract supplies a vi.fn callback directly to PresenterDemoControl and asserts only the persona ID passed to it; it never exercises App.tsx's onViewAs wiring or handleRoleSwitch.
evidence.failureScenario: If handleRoleSwitch stops sending CSRF, navigates before the server succeeds, or accepts an unknown persona, this test still passes because its mock callback only records the ID.

reviewers.summary: The changed UI has no directly evident security bypass, but the named tests do not verify that App preserves the reset and persona-switch security safeguards.

findingList.message: The test does not cover the reset wiring required by the first acceptance criterion. Add a test that exercises the App path and verifies the scoped reset request includes CSRF and revision safeguards.

evidence.codePathTraced: The test clicks the reset button and checks only that the component callback receives the case ID.
evidence.failureScenario: If App stops checking presenter scope or reset eligibility, or submits the reset without CSRF and revision safeguards, this test still passes.

findingList.message: The test does not cover the switch-user behavior required by AC_004. Add a test that exercises the App path and verifies the CSRF-protected request and navigation only after server success.

evidence.codePathTraced: The persona test checks only that the component callback receives a persona ID; it does not exercise App's switch-user request or navigation.
evidence.failureScenario: If App omits CSRF, navigates before the server succeeds, or fails to navigate after success, this test still passes.
